references.text: Refers to wise hearts that God has filled with the spirit of wisdom to make priestly garments, including the same materials mentioned in Exodus 35:25.
God gives wisdom in the heart to all who are skilled, so they can carry out the work on the tabernacle.
Continues the description of the women who spun with wisdom in their hearts, this time using goat hair.
Describes the use of the same materials (blue, purple, scarlet, and fine linen) in making the tabernacle curtains.
God's instructions to use blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, along with finely twisted linen, for the tabernacle curtains.
The skilled woman stretches her hands toward the distaff and holds the spindle, an example of women's skill in spinning.
The skilled woman makes coverings and dresses herself in fine linen and purple, the same materials mentioned in Exodus 35:25.
Exodus 35:25 shows the people's response to God's gift of wisdom, while Exodus 35:35 reveals the source of this wisdom that enables work with the same materials.
